about: Every text the mod adds to VS's own localisation (I2 terms, the same text in every language; --- is I2's mark for an empty text). {type:<characters row>} becomes that character's runtime CharacterType number. The stages' names, descriptions and tips and the goals' texts come from sheets/stages.json (Content.Localize, Content.GoalText).

rows.en: ROUNDS's Orange Guy and Blue Guy fight the night with ROUNDS's gun. Every level-up is a ROUNDS card.
ROUNDS's own gun, fired by your ROUNDS. Aims at the nearest enemy; the mouse aims it too.
Level-ups and chests are ROUNDS card picks that change it.
ROUNDS's orange player with ROUNDS's gun and block. Every level-up is a ROUNDS card pick.
ROUNDS's blue player with ROUNDS's gun and block. Every level-up is a ROUNDS card pick.
